TAIWAN MINISTER’S FIRST MRT RIDE 🚆

LOOK: Taiwan Minister Michael Lee had his first-ever MRT ride.

Lee boarded at the Araneta–Cubao Station, where he observed the train line’s infrastructure and systems before alighting at Ayala Station.

The trip took only 20 minutes, a clear contrast to road travel during peak traffic, according to the post.

Courtesy: Taiwan in the Philippines/Facebook
